learning_outcomes.text: The student knows the value of CO2 emissions for each technology. Can determine the efficiency of appliances.
Student knows basic characteristics of renewable resources.
The student is able to independently find information about the current state of knowledge in the field of renewable energy sources.
The student has basic knowledge necessary to understand non-technical conditions of using various energy sources, including renewable and unconventional sources.

syllabus_topics: geothermal power stations and heat-generating plants
estimation of the power of tidal, wave and osmotic power plant as well as OTEC cycle
calculation of the power of hydropower plant
surface area and efficiency of solar collector
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, students must achieve a passing threshold of 100% for laboratory reports and 56% for the test.
bibliography: Michealides E.E.: Alternative Energy Sources. Springer-Verlag Berlin Heidelberg (2012).
Ghosh T.K., Prelas M.A.: Energy Resources and Systems. Springer Dordrecht Heidelberg London New York (2011).
Kaltschmitt M., Streicher W., Wiese A.: Renewable Energy: Technology Economics and Environment. Springer-Verlag Berlin Heidelberg (2007).
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
